Imâm Shâfi’i holds that there are 12 extra takbeeraat – 7 in the first ra’kah, and 5 in the second. In both of the rak’ât, the takbeeraat are said before the recitation.

Imâm Mâlik and Imâm Hanbal hold that there are 11 extra takbeeraat – 6 only in the first rak’ah and 5 in the second, also said before the recitation.

The prayer of ‘Eid is ordained because the beloved Prophet (pbuh) used to offer this prayer regularly i.e every year.And Imam Shafi’i (rh) said:“Prayer of ‘Eid is urged for those, on whom all the conditions of Jum’ah prayer are fulfilled.
